# pip-audit suppressions — single source for every gate that runs pip-audit
# (ci.yml gate-5, nightly.yml, release-publish.yml). Consumed by
# scripts/pip_audit_gated.sh; pip-audit has no config-file support, so the
# script turns these into repeated --ignore-vuln flags.
#
# Format: one vulnerability ID per line. Blank lines and #-comments ignored.
# Every entry MUST carry a rationale comment directly above it.
#
# EXPIRES: 2026-12-01
#
# The expiry is enforced, not documentary: after that date
# scripts/pip_audit_gated.sh fails and the gate goes red until a human
# re-reviews this file. That is deliberate — a suppression nobody revisits is
# indistinguishable from a disabled scanner.
#
# ── cryptography 44.x, held below 45 for Odoo.sh pyOpenSSL compatibility ──
#
# Why these cannot simply be fixed by upgrading:
#
#   pyproject.toml pins "cryptography>=43.0.0,<45". The ceiling exists because
#   the Odoo.sh container that consumes this SDK (cryptoxdog/IB-Odoo_19) ships
#   an old pyOpenSSL whose compiled bindings break against newer cryptography:
#   a mismatched pair raises `AttributeError: module 'lib' has no attribute
#   'GEN_EMAIL'` at import of `base`, which takes down the entire Odoo registry
#   on every restart (incident 2026-07-16 → 2026-07-24). The consumer pins the
#   exact working pair (cryptography==43.0.3 + pyOpenSSL==24.3.0).
#
#   The advisories below are fixed only in cryptography 46.0.5 and later — up
#   to 50.0.0 for PYSEC-2026-3552. No version satisfies both "<45" and
#   ">=46.0.5", so this is a compatibility conflict, not a deferred upgrade.
#
# Exposure assessment: this SDK uses `cryptography` solely for detached
# signing and signature verification of TransportPacket headers
# (src/constellation_node_sdk/security/). It runs no TLS/X.509 termination,
# parses no attacker-supplied certificates, and exposes no PKCS#7/S-MIME or
# certificate-chain parsing surface — which is where these advisories live.
#
# Removal trigger: the ceiling can be raised, and every line below deleted,
# once the Odoo.sh base image ships a pyOpenSSL that tolerates cryptography
# >= 46, or the consumer stops pulling pyOpenSSL transitively (paramiko,
# josepy). Re-check at the expiry above.
#
# Owner: platform / Gate_SDK maintainers.

# X.509/PKCS#7 parsing paths; fixed in 46.0.6. Not reachable from packet signing.
PYSEC-2026-35

# Fixed in 46.0.5. Certificate-handling path; SDK parses no certificates.
PYSEC-2026-2141

# Fixed in 50.0.0 — the furthest-out fix, and the widest gap from the "<45" ceiling.
PYSEC-2026-3552

# Fixed in 49.0.0.
PYSEC-2026-3553

# Fixed in 49.0.0.
PYSEC-2026-3554

# GHSA alias for the same cryptography 44.x family; fixed in 48.0.1.
GHSA-537c-gmf6-5ccf
